notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 600 x 400 unless the case says; animation false unless the case says.
a step: the clock advanced by dt (the play timers fire at their due instants, each followed by a frame), the step, a frame.
a frame: zr.animation.update(), zr.animation.update(true) at the same instant, the display list refreshed.
TZ=UTC; a time case writes useUTC and epoch-ms data.

cases.note: three timelines: the bottom one, one on top, a vertical value one on the right
the other timelines' ticks, labels and buttons change the FIRST model; '+' / '-' from the clicked view's own index
the second timeline's play button plays the first; its own button keeps saying play
the second timeline plays by itself: its timer sets the first's index from its own, every time the same
both play; the shorter interval fires first, and the render it causes sets every timer again
both play at the same interval: the first's timer fires first, and the update re-arms the second's
the second timeline's checkpoint dragged: realtime against its own index, the release a change
with animation: the first checkpoint slides, the dragged one goes back to its own index
a hover lifts the hovered timeline only
the first timeline hidden: the second still drives its frames
a notMerge to one timeline takes the second view and its timer
